customer: Caller, a veteran in Aldora who bought an electric car, said he's unhappy with it and is fed up trying to figure out whether he can still send it back.
agent: Customer asked about returning the electric car he bought from us. Explained per 'Returning a car you bought from us' that a car can be returned for a full refund within 7 days of delivery and before it's driven 250 miles, as long as it's in the same condition as when he got it. Let him know he can start the return online or at any store.
